The Analyst Programmer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications that support business objectives. Key duties include writing and reviewing code, conducting software testing, and ensuring that application functionality meets specified requirements. The role also involves researching and designing technical solutions, as well as documenting and updating software specifications throughout the development lifecycle.
Responsibilities:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of coding methods, industry best practices, and software development standards.
Conduct interviews with end-users to gather insights into functionality, interface issues, usability, and challenges, ensuring user needs are effectively addressed.
Develop comprehensive test cases and test plans to ensure the reliability and performance of software applications.
Stay informed on data privacy laws and practices to ensure software development remains compliant.
Communicate clearly with non-technical staff and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Embrace new technologies and maintain a commitment to ongoing learning and skill development.
Display excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills to convey ideas and requirements effectively.
Conduct research into software-related challenges and assess potential solutions or products.
Demonstrate initiative, autonomy, and direction in executing work tasks and delivering projects.
Maintain strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision throughout the development process.
Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve complex software-related issues.
Manage task prioritisation and execute effectively under pressure to meet project deadlines.
Collaborate closely with developers, programmers, and designers to conceptualise and develop innovative software solutions.
Evaluate existing business systems and processes to identify optimisation opportunities.
Assist in gathering, defining, and documenting business requirements, deliverables, and specifications in partnership with internal departments.
Contribute to software development project planning, including scope definition, scheduling, and implementation.
Engage with internal and external programme users to understand and fulfil functional requirements.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience working as an Analyst Programmer or in a similar software development role.
Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, or JavaScript.
Strong understanding of database concepts and practical experience writing and optimising SQL queries.
Experience developing web applications using technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular, or ASP.NET.
Familiarity with modern software development methodologies, including Agile and Scrum frameworks.
Sound knowledge of software testing principles, with exposure to tools like JUnit or Selenium.
Experience using version control systems such as Git or SVN, and project tracking tools like JIRA or Trello.
Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, along with their core services and deployment models.
Solid foundation in object-oriented programming (OOP) and commonly used software design patterns.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex coding issues.
Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage tasks, prioritise deliverables, and meet project deadlines.
Self-motivated with a commitment to ongoing learning and staying current with emerging tools and technologies.

result.description: Metalwork WA Pty Ltd   Position Overview   Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and motivated Full-time Metal Fabricator to join its fabrication team in Western Australia. The successful applicant will fabricate, assemble, install, maintain, modify, and repair structural steel and other fabricated metal products by interpreting engineering drawings, preparing metal materials, and carrying out welding and fabrication activities while maintaining high standards of quality, precision, and workplace safety.    Key Responsibilities    Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.  Mark out, measure, cut, shape, and prepare metal sections, plates, pipes, and structural components.  Fabricate, assemble, and install structural steel, frames, platforms, handrails, brackets, truck bodies, and other fabricated metal products.  Fit, align, and join fabricated metal components using appropriate welding processes and fabrication techniques in accordance with engineering specifications.   Operate fabrication equipment including guillotines, press brakes, rollers, drills, saws, grinders, and other workshop machinery.  Inspect fabricated products to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.  Repair, modify, and maintain metal structures and fabricated products as required.  Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety policies and procedures.  Maintain fabrication equipment and tools in a safe operating condition and comply with workplace health and safety procedures throughout all fabrication activities.     Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   A qualification relevant to metal fabrication, engineering fabrication, boilermaking, welding, or a closely related trade equivalent to AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).  Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.  Experience in fabricating, assembling, fitting, installing, modifying, and repairing structural steel and fabricated metal products.   Competency in welding and the safe operation of fabrication machinery and associated hand and power tools.  Strong knowledge of metalworking techniques, measuring equipment, quality control processes, and workplace health and safety requirements.  Good communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment with an established Western Australian steel fabrication company.  Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience.  Opportunity to work on diverse commercial, industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects.  A professional and safety-focused workplace with modern fabrication equipment.  Ongoing opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high-quality fabrication projects.  Supportive team environment with a commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and suitability for the role.  Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company     METALWORK WA PTY LTD  is a Western Australian steel fabrication company specialising in truck body building, structural steel, and architectural steel fabrication. The company provides end-to-end fabrication services, including design, drafting, manufacturing, blasting, painting, and on-site installation for commercial, industrial, construction, and mining clients. Operating from a fully equipped workshop in Perth, Metalwork WA delivers custom metal fabrication solutions, site welding, and steel construction projects while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, workplace safety, and timely project delivery. The company has been actively operating in Australia since 2009 as a registered Australian proprietary company. Job Description
Position Overview:
AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid grasp of software testing methodologies, sharp analytical skills, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality AI software. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.
Perform functional, integration, system, and regression testing to validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI software products.
Identify and document software defects, including clear and detailed reproduction steps, in a bug tracking system. Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard software testing automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium, or Robot Framework) to streamline testing processes and improve test efficiency for AI software applications.
Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test reports, to ensure comprehensive test coverage and facilitate knowledge sharing within the team.
Set up and configure test environments, including hardware, software, and data, to simulate real-world scenarios and ensure accurate testing results.
Continuously evaluate and enhance software testing strategies, methodologies, and tools to improve the overall quality and efficiency of testing processes.
Work closely with the development team, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify issues, and provide timely feedback on the quality of AI software products.
Collaborate with the QA team to establish and maintain quality standards, best practices, and processes across AI software projects.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in software testing methodologies, AI technologies, and industry best practices.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Must have at least 2 years of proven experience as a Software Tester, with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies and practices.
Experience in testing AI software applications and familiarity with AI concepts and technologies.
Solid knowledge of test management tools, bug tracking systems, and test automation frameworks.
Experience with software testing automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Robot Framework, or similar.
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in software testing, such as Python or Java.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and isolate software defects effectively.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to meticulously follow test plans and test cases.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
Relevant certifications in software testing, such as ISTQB, are desirable.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super
